home.classesSubtitle: From strength to stillness - find the practice that meets you where you are.

classCards.body: Low-impact, full-body movement on the reformer, where spring resistance can support you or challenge you - meeting you exactly where you are. It builds core strength, tones the whole body, and improves posture and flexibility, while staying gentle on the joints.

Pilates in its purest form, using only your own body on the mat. Controlled, deliberate movements that build a strong foundation - deep core strength, better posture, and a clearer sense of how your body moves.

For the days you want to build heat. A faster tempo and flowing transitions turn the Pilates method into something more dynamic - stronger, more intense, and deeply engaging, while never losing precision or control.
Breath and movement, woven together. Sessions to stretch, ground, and soften - space to release the day and return to yourself.
bodyLines: Sessions to stretch, ground, and soften - space

classCards.body: A dedicated practice to create space in the body. Gentle, intentional stretches help release tension, improve flexibility, and restore mobility while encouraging your body to slow down. Leave feeling lighter, longer, and more at ease - in both body and mind.

refund.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
refund.metaDescription: How to cancel classes and request package refunds at Ommm. studio.
refund.intro: At Ommm., we know life moves — plans shift, mornings get away from us, and unexpected things come up. This policy exists to keep things fair for everyone: for you, for the women waiting for a spot, and for the instructors who prepare thoughtfully for each class. We've kept it simple.
refund.cancellingP1: You can cancel any class free of charge up to 24 hours before it begins. Your session will be returned to your package, ready to use whenever you're next ready.
refund.cancellingP2: If a class is cancelled less than 24 hours before it begins, or if you do not attend without prior notice, the session will be deducted from your package. Reserved spots are often in high demand, and late cancellations make it difficult for someone else to enjoy that time.
refund.cancellingP3: To cancel a booking, simply use the Ommm. app or website, or contact us by phone or WhatsApp. This helps us keep every schedule accurate and fair.
refund.refundsP1: If you change your mind, you may request a refund within 14 days of your purchase, provided that your package has not expired.
refund.refundsP2: We will refund the value of your package minus the cost of any sessions already used.
refund.refundsP3: After 14 days, packages become non-refundable. However, they don't have to go to waste — unused sessions may be transferred to a friend or family member, so your moment of wellbeing can become theirs.
refund.closing: Thank you for helping us create a thoughtful, respectful community where every spot, every instructor's time, and every member's experience is valued.

story.title: About Ommm.
story.lede: A women's wellness space in the heart of Yerevan — created for movement, calm, and the moment that belongs only to you.
story.featurePauseBody: Every detail invites you to slow down — from the first breath at the door to the quiet after class. This is time set aside for you, without rush or noise.
story.featureCalmBody: Soft light, natural textures, and thoughtful flow through the studio keep the space gentle on the senses. Movement and rest share the same unhurried rhythm.
story.valuesSubtitle: What we stand for in the studio — movement, calm, and community.
story.valuePeaceBody: Classes and rituals that help you arrive in the present — breath, focus, and release from the day behind you.
story.valueStrengthBody: Movement that builds from the inside out — aligned, intentional, and tuned to your body, not someone else's pace.
story.valueCommunityBody: A circle of women who show up for themselves and each other — shared energy without comparison or pressure.
story.founderVoiceQuoteLead: I didn't build Ommm. to add one more thing to your day. I built it to give you one thing back:
story.founderVoicePortraitAlt: Portrait of the Ommm studio founder
story.closingBody: The name carries the sound of an extended exhale — the space between effort and ease. Three letters, one long breath, and a reminder that harmony is something you can return to.
story.closingCallout: This is your moment of harmony.
